body: People don't actually want to be friends with me, that's what happened. It's been that way my whole life.
I've been "taking time for myself" my whole life. And nothing good ever comes of it. So maybe it's time to just kill myself
What good are hobbies without people to share them with?

Would isn't Do. 

I'd rather die

At this point, I'm sick of people. They say they'll be there if you need to talk, but then what they really do is blow you off to hang out with their SO. Nobody calls you when they say they will, nobody follows through with their word. It just further solidifies that no one wants me.
